fullSource:
use default

let fixed = ["apple", "orange", "pear"]

write_line("{$fixed} has {fixed.count}, and fixed[1] is {fixed[1]}")
write_line("an array indexer only reads, so a list carries the writes")

let growing = LIST(fixed)

growing.add("lemon")

growing[0] = "quince"

write_line("{$growing} has {growing.count}, and growing[0] is {growing[0]}")
output:
[apple, orange, pear] has 3, and fixed[1] is orange
an array indexer only reads, so a list carries the writes
[quince, orange, pear, lemon] has 4, and growing[0] is quince
